migration_and_rollback.projection_note: Rollback restores the former two-stage scalar fact materialization and late per-relation bound check. It does not alter public APIs, Fourfold authority, relation semantics or persisted schemas.

title: Collapse scalar relation-fact materialization into one bounded indexed map

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Implement only the GPU-79 frozen production-kernel gardening step. Reduce transient allocation inside the canonical Forest/Fourfold relation compiler without adding another backend, graph authority, cache, public surface or projection owner. Preserve Boolean, Natural and Evidence-DAG observer semantics, exact relation deduplication, Fourfold admission/refusal behavior and TypedRelationBlock ownership.

before.scalar_coordinate_storage: facts[signature][coordinate] allocated an empty evidence-bundle set for every Boolean/Natural semantic coordinate even though scalar observers never consume provenance bundles
before.scalar_block_materialization: each selected relation then allocated a second entries dict and copied every coordinate into True or 1 before TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed
before.entry_bound: MAX_BLOCK_ENTRIES was checked only after the second entries dict had been fully materialized

after.scalar_coordinate_storage: the canonical facts bucket stores the final True/1 scalar directly for Boolean/Natural observers
after.scalar_block_materialization: the same per-signature coordinate map is passed directly to TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed; no second scalar coordinate-value map is built
after.evidence_storage: Evidence-DAG observers retain the existing per-coordinate witness-bundle set and normalize those values to EvidenceValue in the same map before indexed-block construction
after.entry_bound: a new distinct coordinate is refused before insertion when the per-relation facts bucket has reached MAX_BLOCK_ENTRIES

semantic_invariants.boolean_duplicate_witnesses: collapse to one semantic coordinate with value true
semantic_invariants.natural_duplicate_witnesses: collapse to one semantic coordinate with value 1; ingest witness multiplicity is not path multiplicity
semantic_invariants.evidence_dag_duplicate_witnesses: retain canonical alternative witness bundles and materialize one EvidenceValue per semantic coordinate
semantic_invariants.source_of_truth: KnowledgeForest plus verified FourfoldSnapshot remain authority; relation blocks remain regenerable computational projections
semantic_invariants.indexed_block_owner: TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed remains the single CSR materialization owner
semantic_invariants.bound_behavior: duplicate facts at an existing coordinate remain admissible at the bound; only a new coordinate beyond MAX_BLOCK_ENTRIES is refused

result.summary: Boolean and Natural compilation now keep their final scalar in the already-required bounded per-signature fact map and hand that same map to the existing indexed CSR owner. This deletes the compiler's second scalar coordinate map and the unused empty evidence-set allocation while making the per-relation entry ceiling fail before growth.
